title: Identity, References, and Lifecycle
description: UUIDv7 minting, slugs scoped per kind, URIs, nodes, and lifecycle rules.
body: PRD section 3 gives every element two identifiers and puts a hard line between them: the `id` is what a reference stores, and the `slug` is what a person reads. Renaming changes the slug alone, so nothing inbound breaks. Uniqueness is per scope and the scope differs by kind. Two modules named `cache` are legal under different parents and illegal under the same one.
